title: Tracn Inc. - Delaware, USA
body: Data Engineer working remotely from Bhubaneswar. Architect and maintain the company's data engineering platform (Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Neo4j) powering ingestion, storage, and retrieval of heterogeneous, graph-structured data.
Build ingestion and transformation pipelines that normalize data from APIs, structured sources, and web-based acquisition into a consistent, queryable format.
Enforce data quality with Pandera/Pydantic-based validation, along with provenance and audit trails that trace every record back to its source.
Ship internal Streamlit tools for pipeline operations, data review, and QA, streamlining day-to-day operational workflows.
Cover ingestion workflows with offline, fixture-based automated tests, removing reliance on live external sources during development.
Containerize and deploy services with Docker on Railway for repeatable, maintainable production releases.
